request.description: On 14.11.2026 I was reversing out of a parking space and hit a concrete pillar. The rear bumper is broken. The workshop quoted 3 850 PLN.
A stone from a truck cracked my windscreen on the motorway on 2026-10-03. Replacement costs 1 900 PLN.
My car was stolen from the street in front of my house during the night of 5 November 2026. It was locked. I reported it to the police the next morning. The car is worth 42 000 PLN.
On 21.09.2026 I crashed into a fence on the way home from a party. I had a few beers before driving. Repair estimate: 7 400 PLN.
Large hail damaged the roof and bonnet of my car on 2026-07-12 while it was parked outside. The body shop estimates 12 300 PLN.
A pipe burst under the kitchen sink on 03.11.2026 and flooded the floor. Damaged floor panels and a cabinet: 4 200 PLN. My email is jan.k@example.com.
There has been damp and mould behind the bathroom tiles for months; a slow leak from the shower. I noticed it on 2026-10-20. Repair costs 6 000 PLN.
Burglars broke in through the balcony door on 12 October 2026 and stole a laptop and jewellery worth 9 500 PLN. The police came the same evening.
A fire started in the kitchen when a pan caught fire. Smoke damaged the walls and ceiling. Please tell me what to do next.
I got a high fever in Spain on 2026-08-02 and spent two nights in hospital. The hospital bills come to 8 700 PLN. Please call me on +48 123 456 789, PESEL 44051401359.
The airline lost my suitcase on the flight to Lisbon on 15.09.2026. I have the property irregularity report. Contents worth 2 300 PLN.
I had to see a doctor in Croatia on 2026-07-28 because of my chronic back condition, already diagnosed last year. Treatment cost 1 500 PLN.
I broke my leg two days before departure and had to cancel the trip booked for 10 June 2026. The non-refundable cost is 6 400 PLN; I have a doctor's certificate.
Water was leaking from the neighbour's apartment above and stained my ceiling on 2026-11-08. Painting and a new ceiling lamp: 2 100 PLN.
